title: Accessibility Description Grammar
purpose: Deterministic structured nonvisual description and change-announcement grammar for appearance state and renderer projection.

must_include_when_known: governed limb/appendage structure relevant to appearance

surface.rule: Only terms actually authorized by source/profile choices may be emitted.

coloration.source: semantic palette zones and authored choices
coloration.rule: Color names always have textual labels; color is never the sole state carrier.

distinguishing_features.source: authorized markings, structural features, persistent markers, and permission-safe history projection
distinguishing_features.rule: Persistent/source-owned markers are described but not presented as cosmetically removable.

wardrobe.rule: Explicitly presentation-only where ambiguity with actual owned equipment is possible.

equipment_projection.rule: Description reports visible projection only and does not claim ownership/equip mechanics beyond authorized state.

renderer_support.rule: Missing visual coverage must be described without implying the Character state is invalid.

sentence_grammar.empty: No authorized appearance description is available.
sentence_grammar.ordering: stable section order then case-insensitive lexical fact order

announcement_rules: Announce semantic changed fields, not pixel coordinates or animation-only differences.
Do not announce hidden before/after values when either side is unauthorized.
Do not infer causality or mechanics from a visual change.
Multiple changes are deterministically ordered by stable field identifier.
Preview regeneration with no semantic change does not produce a semantic change announcement.

permission_filtering.stage: before description assembly and before change comparison output

special_case_requirements: Vespin descriptions preserve four-arm topology when authorized.
Moravi descriptions preserve two-arm/four-leg topology when authorized.
Suula nested hand/claw structure is described as nested structure when authorized rather than flattened.
ManyToms description identifies composite/constituent presentation without asserting an exact rendered constituent count unless upstream state supplies it.
Arborae current season is identified as upstream state and authored seasonal appearance profile as appearance state.
Nekron transition appearance never describes an unavailable ascension as selected.
Unknown Munyubbles/Wogol morphology remains explicitly unknown rather than described as humanoid.
Thetan occupied/current body description follows upstream body authority rather than Species default anatomy.
